labels.introduction: Discover opportunities to connect, grow in faith, and serve our community.

ministries.title: Children's Ministry
ministries.description: Our Children's Ministry helps children discover God's love, learn about the Bible, and develop their faith through spiritual education and fellowship.

ministries.title: Youth Ministry
ministries.description: Our Youth Ministry provides opportunities for young people to grow in their relationship with Christ, build meaningful friendships, and support one another through life's challenges.

ministries.title: Outreach Ministry
ministries.description: Our Outreach Ministry serves the community through charitable activities, evangelism, and practical assistance to people in need.

ministries.title: Music Ministry
ministries.description: Our Music Ministry brings people together to worship God through singing, choir, orchestra, and opportunities for musical education.

ministries.title: Women's Ministry
ministries.description: Our Women's Ministry encourages spiritual growth, friendship, and mutual support through Bible study, fellowship, and service.

ministries.title: Missionary Work
ministries.description: Our missionary activities focus on sharing the gospel, providing humanitarian assistance, supporting education, and encouraging others to serve.

ministries.title: Bible School
ministries.description: Our Bible School offers opportunities to study Scripture through group discussions and individual Bible lessons in multiple languages.
